title: STOPS-1: backtest of the declared -8% stop and -4% reduce rules on VN30 portfolios, development window only
question: Do the decision engine's declared risk rules (hard stop at -8% vs average cost, reduce at -4% when the trend is bearish) improve net CAGR, Sharpe or max drawdown of an equal-weight VN30 portfolio and of the B-mom_6 top-10 portfolio after HOSE costs, compared with the same portfolios without the rules?

sourceRules.levels: avgCost x (1 - fraction) rounded UP onto the HOSE tick grid (10 below 10,000, 50 below 50,000, else 100 VND; adjusted prices)
sourceRules.trigger: 1d close at or below the level
sourceRules.reduceCondition: reduce fires only when the trend is bearish: 1d close < SMA50 of closes and Wilder RSI14 < 50 (as the backend), and the stop is not hit
sourceRules.reduceQuantity: the backend's reduce action carries no quantity; declared here: sell the lot-rounded-down half of the held shares (all shares when that is 0 lots), at most once per symbol between two rebalance entries

data.prices: adjusted daily OHLCV (VCI) from the snapshot, zero-volume bars dropped, VHM excludeBefore honored; the VNINDEX session calendar
data.truncation: every bar dated after 2023-12-31 is removed before the simulation starts

window.firstDecision: vn30-2 decisionSchedule.firstDecision (first session with >= 260 prior sessions for >= 20 members)
window.holdout: the vn30-2 holdout (2024-01-01 onward) is not read

portfolios.engine: vn_portfolio_backtest.run_backtest with PortfolioRules.from_protocol(vn30-2.json); defaults kept: cashSettlementSessions 0 (same-session buying power, no advance interest), shares sellable from the open of T+2, limit-lock proxy 1.065 / 0.935, 1 tick slippage, fee 0.15% per side, sell tax 0.1%, lot 100, initial cash 10,000,000,000 VND

list.rule: B-ew: equal weight of every VN30 member in force with >= 260 bars (top_k None)
B-mom_6: rank by mom_6 = close(d) / close 126 bars earlier - 1 over the symbol's own bars dated <= d (no score with fewer than 127 bars); top 10, keep while rank <= 15
no risk exit (control; the same configurations as hose-vn30-2 B-ew and B-mom_6, counted there)

variants.averageCost: share-weighted mean of the fill prices (open +/- slippage, fees excluded) of the shares currently held; a sell leaves it unchanged; it resets when the position reaches 0
variants.evaluation: at the close of every simulated session that is not a decision session (a decision's rebalance at the next open supersedes every open order), for each held symbol with a bar that session
variants.execution: a fired rule becomes a sell order for the open of the next session with the backtester's fill rules (limit-lock proxy, settled shares only, retried every session until filled or superseded by the next rebalance); a stop replaces any open order of that symbol; no rule fires for a symbol with an open sell order
variants.reentry: sale proceeds stay in cash until the next rebalance, where the name can be bought again if selected

trials: 4 new configurations (stop-8 and stop-8+reduce-4 on each of P-ew and P-mom6); the 2 controls are hose-vn30-2 baselines

perSeries: annualized Sharpe of daily net returns (mean / sd x sqrt(252), rf 0)
count of stop and reduce sell fills
metrics.dsr: vn30_panel_eval.deflated_sharpe on daily returns with N = HOSE trial count (statuses run + planned) from trial_registry at evaluation time; (a) each of the 6 daily net return series with V[SR] = vn30_panel_eval.sr_variance over the 6; (b) each stop variant's daily excess over its own control (variant - none, same portfolio) with V[SR] over the 4 excess series

decisionRule: a variant is 'supported' for a portfolio only if, versus its control, net CAGR is higher, Sharpe is higher, max drawdown is shallower AND the DSR of its daily excess is >= 0.95; otherwise 'not supported' (the rule stays a declared risk preference, not an evidenced improvement)
outputs: btc-ai/docs/research/evidence/vn30-2/stops-1-<UTC stamp>/result.json (gitignored), with the snapshot sha256, this file's sha256 and the registry head
knownLimitations: one development window, 30 names, 6 years: low power; a null result is the expected outcome
adjusted prices: levels and ticks follow adjusted, not traded, prices
the 50% reduce quantity is a declared choice, not the backend's (which has none)
same-session buying power after sales (cashSettlementSessions 0) is the backtester default
